records.text: An anonymous source claimed that $150 million was spent on the first operation against Tucker Carlson and Candace Owens.
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #3 (Ep 2WEHTk0Xewg)

appearances.snippet: I'm getting to the bottom of this. And lastly, I want to say to this—like "new flex Operation Mocking Pastor"—regarding which, by the way, the first time they went after Tucker (Tucker Carlson) and Candace (Candace Owens), a source told me—and I would love to get this confirmed— I'm going to find this out—that $150 million was spent on that. ... And it came from Benjamin Netanyahu.

verification.notes: Specific financial figures and their alleged source require documentation that is not publicly available. This extraordinary claim would need extraordinary evidence.
